functions.name: init
functions.description: Installs the UI hooks, applies the initial config and returns which features found their hook points.

functions.name: setIcons
functions.description: Maps card ids to { dataUrl, unverified, pending, initials, color, generation }, where dataUrl is a base64 image data: URL or null and results from before the last clearIcons() are dropped.

functions.name: clearIcons
functions.description: Forgets all icon results so visible cards are requested again.

functions.name: listServers
functions.description: Lists the incoming servers of all accounts as [{ key, name, type }].

functions.name: sampleAuthResults
functions.description: Returns Authentication-Results values of the newest locally stored messages (reading at most 200 per folder) in every inbox and displayed folder as { [serverKey]: string[] }.

functions.name: getThunderbirdSettings
functions.description: Thunderbird's own settings shown on the options page: listView ("cards" or "table"), markReadOnView, unifiedFolders and glodaIndex.

functions.name: setThunderbirdSetting
functions.description: Changes one of Thunderbird's own settings.

functions.name: applyViewToAllFolders
functions.description: Sets every folder of every account (and the default for new folders) to grouped by date or to threaded conversations.

events.name: onCardsRendered
events.description: Fired with a batch of card descriptors ({ id, email, displayName, authResults, serverKey, generation }) that have no icon result yet.
